facts.target_customer: Individuals seeking life insurance protection with investment opportunities for themselves and their families.

facts.premium_payment_modes: Single Pay, Annual, Half-yearly, Quarterly, Monthly
facts.waiting_periods: Rider Sum Assured shall be payable in case you are diagnosed with any of the 19 Critical Illnesses and survive for a period of 30 days following the diagnosis.
facts.free_look_period: from the date of receipt of the policy, as per IRDAI (Protection of Policyholders' Interests) Regulations, 2024, as modified from time to time.
facts.tax_benefits: Tax benefits may be available as per prevailing tax laws
